scripts.test:ci-projects: node --test scripts/ci-projects.test.mjs scripts/check-workspace-deps.test.mjs scripts/cli-nightly-version.test.mjs scripts/cli-nightly-watchdog.test.mjs scripts/platform-setup-pr.test.mjs scripts/codemod-version-changed.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-deployment.test.mjs scripts/deploy-workflow.test.mjs scripts/migrate-cloudflare-token.test.mjs scripts/oxc-config.test.mjs scripts/cli-lint-rules.test.mjs scripts/workflow-policy.test.mjs scripts/tsconfig-policy.test.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter '@sentry/mcp-cloudflare...' --if-present run build && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --parallel --filter @sentry/mcp-cloudflare --filter @sentry/mcp-core --filter @sentry/mcp-server-mocks --if-present run dev
scripts.dev:stdio: pnpm --filter '@sentry/mcp-core...' --if-present run build 1>&2 && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --silent --dir packages/cli run cli mcp
scripts.build:cli: dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --filter sentry run build && pnpm --filter sentry-cli-docs run build
scripts.deploy:docs: pnpm --filter sentry run generate:docs && pnpm --filter sentry-cli-docs run build && pnpm --filter sentry-cli-docs run deploy
scripts.eval: pnpm --filter '@sentry/mcp-server-evals...' --if-present run build && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --filter @sentry/mcp-server-evals run eval
scripts.eval:ci: pnpm --filter '@sentry/mcp-server-evals...' --if-present run build && CI=true dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --stream -r run eval:ci
scripts.lint: oxlint --report-unused-disable-directives . && pnpm run lint:format && pnpm run lint:ast-grep && pnpm run lint:deps
scripts.inspector:stdio: pnpx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@latest -- pnpm --silent --dir packages/cli run cli mcp
scripts.test: pnpm run build && dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm -r --filter '!@sentry/mcp-smoke-tests' --if-present run test
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run build && CI=true dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- pnpm --stream -r run test:ci
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck

scripts.test: pnpm --filter sentry exec node script/ensure-generated.mjs schema grammar && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter sentry exec node script/ensure-generated.mjs && tsc -b

scripts.dev: node --experimental-strip-types --import ./script/require-shim.mjs script/generate.ts docs sdk && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./script/require-shim.mjs --import ./script/strip-arg-separator.mjs src/bin.ts
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sentry/mcp-core run build && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./script/require-shim.mjs script/generate.ts docs sdk && pnpm ts script/build.ts --single
scripts.build:all: pnpm --filter @sentry/mcp-core run build && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./script/require-shim.mjs script/generate.ts docs sdk && pnpm ts script/build.ts
scripts.bundle: pnpm --filter @sentry/mcp-core run build && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./script/require-shim.mjs script/generate.ts docs sdk && pnpm ts script/bundle.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @sentry/mcp-core run build && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./script/require-shim.mjs script/generate.ts docs sdk && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p script && tsc --noEmit -p test
scripts.lint: pnpm -w exec oxlint --report-unused-disable-directives packages/cli && pnpm -w exec oxfmt --check packages/cli
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm -w exec oxlint --fix packages/cli && pnpm -w exec oxfmt --write packages/cli
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --import ./script/require-shim.mjs script/generate.ts docs sdk && vitest run test/lib test/commands test/types test/script --coverage
scripts.test:changed: node --experimental-strip-types --import ./script/require-shim.mjs script/generate.ts docs sdk && vitest run --changed
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm ts script/prepare-e2e-bundle.ts && vitest run test/e2e
scripts.ci:policy: pnpm run check:patches && pnpm run check:deps && pnpm run check:errors && pnpm run check:fragments && pnpm run check:docs-sections && pnpm run check:env-coverage && pnpm run check:stale-refs && pnpm run check:doc-examples && pnpm run check:installer-docs && pnpm run check:destructive

scripts.test: pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.7 jssg test -l typescript ./scripts/codemod.ts

scripts.test:ci: pnpm run generate-definitions && pnpm run validate-skills && vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile=tests.junit.xml

scripts.bundle: pnpm --filter @sentry/mcp-core run build && pnpm --filter sentry run generate && node --experimental-strip-types --import ../../scripts/strip-types-resolve.mjs script/bundle.ts
